semantics.how: Pipes the paths NUL-separated into git check-ignore with a fixed argv and no shell, returning an empty set on any non-zero status
semantics.what: Returns the subset of relative paths git ignores under a root
semantics.when: Called by listFilesContained and docs discovery
semantics.why: Ignored files exist locally but not in a clone, so analyzing them would make the committed store disagree with CI
